---
title: Maccheroncini with Sardines
id: MAR-0085
lang: en
source_lang: it
servings: 4
time_min: 25
difficulty: easy
---
## Ingredients
- 280 g maccheroncini
- 12 sardines
- 40 g breadcrumbs
- 4 tablespoons extra virgin olive oil
- 1 garlic clove
- to taste salt
## Method
1. Crush the garlic and peel it.
2. Fillet the sardines, removing the scales.
3. Soften the garlic in a pan for 2 minutes with 2 tablespoons of oil.
4. Remove it, add the sardines and cook for one minute per side, then sprinkle with breadcrumbs.
5. Cook the maccheroncini in plenty of salted boiling water, drain them, pour them into a serving bowl, season with the sardines with breadcrumbs and the remaining oil, mix gently and serve.
